description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB_firebird' which implements a Firebird database driver for the ADOdb abstraction layer. It includes methods for connecting to a Firebird database, managing transactions, executing queries, retrieving metadata such as columns, indexes, and tables, handling blobs, and format-specific SQL functions relevant to Firebird.

classes.name: ADODB_firebird
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a Firebird database driver for ADOdb, with methods for connection management, transaction control, metadata retrieval, blob handling, and query execution tailored to Firebird SQL syntax and features.

classes.name: ADORecordset_firebird
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet providing result set handling for Firebird, including field information caching, data fetching, blob decoding, and case conversion for field names.

methods.name: setTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction isolation and behavior mode for Firebird transactions.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a Firebird database, with support for persistent connections and configuration options.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Creates a persistent connection to the Firebird database.

methods.name: metaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: serverInfo
methods.description: Provides information about the Firebird server, including dialect and version.

methods.name: metaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves indexes for a specified table.

methods.name: metaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column metadata for a specified table.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence object in the database.

methods.name: genID
methods.description: Generates a sequential ID, creating the sequence if it does not exist.

methods.name: selectDB
methods.description: Selects a database, not applicable for Firebird in this implementation.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement for execution.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query with optional parameters.
